description.value: Optimized voxel-based morphometry study examining gray matter volume differences between Chinese heroin-dependent subjects and healthy controls using structural MRI.

spans.text: In the present study, optimized VBM was used to examine the GM volume difference between Chinese heroin-dependent subjects and healthy controls.

value: We expected to observe that heroin dependence is associated with MRI-detectable GM changes, particularly in the frontal and cingulate cortices.
